  CITY OF SANTA MONICA

  CITY COUNCIL MINUTES

  MAY 14, 2024

  A special meeting of the Santa Monica City Council was called to order by Mayor Brock at 4:34 p.m., on
  Tuesday, May 14, 2024, at City Council Chambers, 1685 Main Street, Santa Monica, CA and 2319 14th Street
  #7, Santa Monica, CA 90401

  Roll Call:  Present:  Mayor Phil Brock
  Mayor Pro Tem Lana Negrete (via telephone)
  Councilmember Gleam Davis (arrived at 5:28 p.m.)
  Councilmember Oscar de la Torre
  Councilmember Christine Parra
  Councilmember Caroline Torosis (arrived at 5:32 p.m.)
  Councilmember Jesse Zwick

  Also Present:  City Manager David White
  City Attorney Douglas Sloan
  Interim City Clerk Nikima S. Newsome

  CONVENE/PLEDGE  On order of the Mayor, the City Council convened at 4:34 p.m., with all
  members present except Councilmembers Davis and Torosis.

  PUBLIC INPUT FOR  No members of the public commented on these items.
  CLOSED SESSION AND
  SPECIAL AGENDA
  ITEMS ONLY:

  LEVINE ACT  Pursuant to the Levine Act (Govt Code Section 84308), any party to a
  DISCLOSURE  permit, license, contract, or other entitlement before the Council is
  required to disclose on the record any contribution, including
  aggregated contributions, of more than $250 made by the party or the
  party's agents within the preceding 12 months to any City official.
  Participants and agents are requested to make this disclosure as well.
  The disclosure must include the name of the party, participant, or
  agent, and any other person making the contribution; the name of the
  recipient, the amount of the contribution, and the date the contribution
  was made.

  PROCLAMATIONS/  3.A. Proclamation: Asian American Pacific Islander (AAPI)
  COMMENDATIONS/  Heritage Month, was presented.
  SPECIAL AGENDA

  1  May 14, 2024
 DocuSign Envelope ID: 68E88E6D-0DB6-4690-901C-9618BD79FDF5

  ITEMS  3.B.  Proclamation: Public Works Week, was presented.

  Councilmember Davis  3.C.  Proclamation: Mental Health Awareness Month, was presented.
  arrived at 5:28 p.m.
  3.D. Proclamation: Preservation Month, was presented.
  Councilmember Torosis
  arrived at 5:32 p.m.  3.E. Commendation: Gilbert's El Indio, was presented.

  3.F. City Manager Report- 1) Fire Department Staff Recognition and
  2) Local Aging & Disability Action Planning, was presented.

  AGENDA  Motion by Mayor Brock, seconded by Councilmember Torosis to hear Item
  MANAGEMENT  4.A. during the regular City Council meeting. Motion was carried
  unanimously by roll call vote with all members present.

  CLOSED SESSIONS  4.A. Conference with legal counsel – anticipated litigation – Gov.
  Code 54956.9(d)(2): 1 case (Initiative to Partially Exempt Multifamily
  Developments from Part of the Third Tier Transfer Tax)

  This item was continued to be heard in conjunction with the closed session
  items on the May 14, 2024, regular City Council meeting agenda.

  ADJOURNMENT  On order of the Mayor, the City Council meeting adjourned at 5:50 p.m.
